name: tdd-frontend-handoff
description: Verify @tdd consults frontend before Red and delegates only implementation after Red.
input: Use the project's TDD frontend workflow for one minimal, dependency-free navigation accessibility slice. Before writing any test, dispatch @frontend in consultation mode with the slice goal and candidate paths (tests/Shell/frontend_eval_fixture_test.js and cdn/js/frontend_eval_fixture.js) to obtain the standards checklist and permitted paths. Then, as @tdd, author the failing test yourself at tests/Shell/frontend_eval_fixture_test.js using only Node built-ins (require + assert): require ../../cdn/js/frontend_eval_fixture.js and assert that its exported navigationState(isOpen) returns accessibility state for closed/open navigation, including ariaExpanded and hidden values for both states. Run it with node tests/Shell/frontend_eval_fixture_test.js and confirm a meaningful Red (module-not-found or missing-behavior failure). Then dispatch @frontend in implementation mode with the selected behavior, the complete failing output, and the permitted path cdn/js/frontend_eval_fixture.js only. After frontend returns, rerun node tests/Shell/frontend_eval_fixture_test.js yourself and verify Green. Retain coverage, check, and commit-message ownership and do not commit within this eval. Do not use vendor, node_modules, a browser server, installs, dependencies, network, credentials, or generated assets.
expected_behavior: The agent consults @frontend for a standards checklist and permitted paths before writing the failing test
The agent writes and runs the failing test itself and confirms a meaningful Red result
The agent sends the selected behavior, failing output, and permitted paths to @frontend for implementation
The agent reruns the test and verifies Green after frontend returns
The agent retains coverage and commit-message ownership and does not ask frontend to commit
